name: Bain's Bench Eatery & Bar
description_short: Blanco roadside gem serving hearty breakfasts, burgers, and cocktails with mountain views.
description_long:
Tucked along the R404 in Blanco, Bain's Bench has become a favourite pit stop between George and the coast. The relaxed atmosphere combines roadside convenience with proper sit-down quality — think generous all-day breakfasts, juicy burgers, and a bar that knows its way around a good cocktail. The mountain backdrop adds to the appeal, especially if you snag a spot on the outdoor deck.

The menu covers breakfast through to dinner with American-style comfort food done well. Their burgers earn consistent praise, and the coffee keeps locals and travellers coming back. It's the kind of place that works whether you're fuelling up for a day trip, meeting mates for a casual lunch, or stopping in for sundowners. Service is friendly without fuss, and the vibe stays laid-back no matter how busy they get.
